title: ALMA High-resolution Observation for the Transitional Disk Around IRAS 04125+2902
question: What are the dust and gas structures of the transitional disk around the transiting-planet host IRAS 04125+2902, and is there an inner disk misaligned with the outer disk?

data.angular_resolution: CLEAN continuum beam 0.151''x0.107'', PA 21.0 deg; SpM effective 0.109''x0.090''
data.sensitivity: continuum rms 1.0 mJy arcsec^-2 (~19 uJy/beam); CO 3.8 mJy/beam at 0.2 km/s

what.value: SMA 345 GHz flux ~41.0±1.0 mJy used for spectral index

evidence.quote: Based on the flux density of the SMA observations in (cite: Espaillat_2015) ($\sim$41.0$\pm$1.0 mJy at 345 GHz)

what.value: Stellar mass 0.7 Msun for Keplerian curve; planet and binary inclinations ~90 deg

evidence.quote: The Keplerian curve for a stellar mass $M_\ast$=0.7 $M_\odot$ (cite: Barber_2024)

what.value: Stellar luminosity 0.4-0.5 Lsun used for RADMC temperature

evidence.quote: estimated from the stellar luminosity $L_\ast$=0.4-0.5 $L_\odot$ (cite: Espaillat_2015; Testi_2022)

recipe.method: tclean MFS, Briggs, two rounds self-cal
PRIISM l1+TSV imaging with 10-fold cross validation

recipe.goal: Disk geometry and ring/flux/radius measurement and dust mass
recipe.method: Ellipse fit to ring, Gaussian fit to deprojected radial profile, curve-of-growth flux and R95, optically thin dust mass
assumptions: kappa=2.3 cm^2/g, T_dust=20 K, d=160.1 pc, optically thin

recipe.method: Moment maps, PV diagram vs Keplerian curves, LTE optically thin column density, curve of growth on redshifted side doubled
assumptions: X_CO=1e-4, T_ex=50 K; alternative CO-to-H2 factor 2.0e20

recipe.method: protomidpy Fourier-Bessel series with Gaussian Process kernel, MCMC, baselines limited to 1.2 Mlambda; residual dirty map via tclean zero iterations
key_parameters: 1000 iterations, 32 walkers, init from SpM cos i and PA

recipe.method: Spectral index between VLASS 70 uJy upper limit and 0.13 mJy SpM inner flux

recipe.goal: Radiative transfer test of inner-disk misalignment
recipe.method: RADMC-3D mctherm with Gaussian ring surface densities, inner disk tilted by Delta i of 10 and 50 deg, convolved to SpM resolution
key_parameters: T0=230 K at 1 au with r^-0.5; Mstar=1.0 Msun; inner r_peak 3 au sigma 2 au; outer r_peak 41 au sigma 5 au; Delta PA=-18.8 deg
assumptions: f_set=1.0, amorphous olivine opacity (50% Mg, 50% Fe)

evidence.quote: The values of $i_{\rm disk}$ and PA$_{\rm disk}$ were estimated to be 35.6$\pm$0.2$^\circ$ and 175.1$\pm$0.5$^\circ$
the width (FWHM) of the ring in the SpM image was estimated to be 21.7$\pm$7.4 au
we estimated the spectral index of $\sim$2.7
We estimated that the systemic velocity was $\sim$7.7 km s$^{-1}$.
We therefore consider that the lower limit of gas mass is 0.2-5.8$\times 10^{-5}\,M_{\odot}$.
the dynamical mass of the central star is estimated to be 0.7-1.0 $M_{\odot}$
we estimated the ring width in the 1D model image to be 17.4$\pm$3.9 au

answer_key.quantity: Spectral index inner emission vs VLASS limit

not_stated_but_needed: Number of CLEAN iterations, threshold, cell and image size, masks for continuum
Line-free channels / continuum subtraction for CO
Priors on the protomidpy MCMC and Fourier-Bessel setup
RADMC-3D photon counts, grid extent, dust-to-gas details
Gridding and range of hyperparameter search for SpM
missing_for_reproduction: Line-free channels and CO continuum subtraction
score_reason: Public data and many parameters are given, but key imaging and fitting settings are missing and some values are inconsistent.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, main results numeric (inclination, flux, R95, dust mass), and the recipe is largely stated.
